Deductions: sentence-form '~다' headings L72 '간접 인젝션: 공격자가 대화 밖으로 나가다' and L189 'PAIR: 공격자 LLM으로 질의 수를 줄이다'; thin cards BadAgent L269-273 and RAGForensics L321-325 (two short paragraphs each); comparison table omits SmoothLLM and ETDI (22 rows for 24 papers); table sits after the three subsections that discuss it.
score_evidence.B: Register break in a table cell caps B at 7: L696 '... 합성 앱·로컬 HTML로 시험했다.' Pipeline-internal meta in the prose: L519 '수치는 여기서 다루는 자료에 없어, 격차를 %나 %p로 적을 수는 없습니다', L551 '구체적 값은 여기서 다루는 자료에 없습니다', L605/L619 '이 수치가 상대값인지 %p인지는 원문에서 구분되지 않습니다'. Formulaic frames: '다음과 같습니다' x4 (L86, L135, L259, L575), '~다는 점입니다' L143, L237. Redundant L519 'Instruct 모델 결과에서는 ... Instruct 모델 결과를 담은 이 그림에서'. Raw identifier in table L698 'combination_3'.
score_evidence.C: Dangling figure reference L133 '아래 그림은 두 에이전트에 대해 방어별 ASR과 적응형 공격 후 ASR을 비교합니다.' (the figure was dropped; result warnings list both 2503.00061 figures as not served). L673 says the table shows '각 공격의 접근 가정과 각 방어의 공격 성공률·유틸리티' but its columns are 주요 결과/한계; L685 '표에서 더 아래에 놓입니다' refers to detector/sandwich/tool-filter rows the table does not have. Synthesis sections re-tell cards: StruQ vs GCG partial L477 -> L655 -> L677; Claude-2 hacking prompt L577 -> L679; CaMeL scope L553 -> L689; AgentDojo knowledge ablation L605 -> L679. Sensitivity/conversion-rate definitions repeated verbatim L577 and L583.
score_evidence.D: Good help at hard points: SecAlign DPO worked example with log 2 (L507), GCG discrete-token step (L173), PoisonedRAG retrieval/generation conditions (L249), CaMeL provenance walk-through (L539). Over-padding: '이메일 비서' 42 times, with repeated '이 경우도 가상 예시입니다' (L397, L427) and analogies on trivial points (L591, L631).
score_evidence.E: Timeline table, comparison table, equations (L121-131, L167, L215, L245-303, L375, L502) and 39 figures placed where discussed and described without paper numbering. Deductions: missing figure behind L133; table cells with prose or no unit ('정량 수치 없음' L696, 'ASR 3.8' without % L703, 'combination_3 GPT-4 0.94 / Claude 0.81' L698).
score_evidence.F: 13/15 sampled claims supported; two table limitation cells are not the paper's: MCP attack vectors 'Cline 단일 클라이언트 고정' (L715) is wrong because Benchmark 2 compares five clients, which the post itself reports at L417; ToolHijacker 'gradient-based 섀도 LLM 의존성(최저 34%)' (L716) is one Table VII cell (Llama-2-7B shadow -> Llama-3-70B target) presented as a limitation, and the paper states no such limitation. Minor scope loss: Prompt Infection '+209% (상대)' (L709) is only for scam/malware/content-manipulation; data theft goes the other way.
